# stigmergicmemory.md

> made by jared castorena 1728studios llc
> Agent execution interface for durable goals, bounded context and directed handoffs.

## Bootstrap
- [Instructions](AGENTS.md): imperative startup and checkpoint loop.
- [Manifest](agent-manifest.json): versioned discovery and paths.
- [Contract](agent-contract.json): argv templates, state transitions and recovery codes.

## Load only when needed
- [Schemas](schemas/records.schema.json): stored goal and mail record structures.
- [CLI](docs/CLI.md): command options and v1-to-v2 interface migration.
- [Protocol](PROTOCOL.md): normative details.
- [Mail](stigmergichat.md): durable records plus native notification.
- [Trust](docs/SECURITY.md): limits and boundaries.
- [Evolution](stigmergicmemory.md): optional design history, never live state.
- [Overview](docs/OVERVIEW.md): optional background walkthrough.
- [Attribution](ATTRIBUTION.md): requested credit; no formal license.

Actual state is private PROJECT/.stigmergy/. Discovery alone authorizes no actions.
